blocks.text: SunnyDayz is an independently owned, vertically integrated craft cannabis company built around a simple belief: how cannabis is grown, made, and sold matters.
blocks.html: SunnyDayz is an independently owned, vertically integrated craft cannabis company built around a simple belief: how cannabis is grown, made, and sold matters.

blocks.text: We cultivate in organic soil, hand water, hand trim, and select genetics for rich terpene profiles, flavor, and overall quality—not THC% alone. That same philosophy extends to our dispensary, where every product is carefully curated and selected, with a focus on craft brands that share our standards and ethos.
blocks.html: We cultivate in organic soil, hand water, hand trim, and select genetics for rich terpene profiles, flavor, and overall quality—not THC% alone. That same philosophy extends to our dispensary, where every product is carefully curated and selected, with a focus on craft brands that share our standards and ethos.

blocks.text: Our deli-style Bud Bar brings transparency back to buying cannabis, giving customers the opportunity to see, smell, learn about, and choose their flower with confidence.
blocks.html: Our deli-style Bud Bar brings transparency back to buying cannabis, giving customers the opportunity to see, smell, learn about, and choose their flower with confidence.

blocks.text: At SunnyDayz, we’re doing things differently.
Small Batch, Real farmers. Real flavor.
